tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Night is the crest's stadium navy; Day is a pale pitch-side grey.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies and modals sitting on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, input wells, the sidebar behind the nav.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline row dividers and card edges. Decorative only; not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, focus-adjacent outlines (3:1 on surface-raised).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, column headers, units (Rep, €, yrs) on any surface.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Crest gold, the brand colour. Primary buttons, trophies, captain armband, active nav. Fill: always set on-gold text on it.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold as text: trophy counts, records, 'Champions' labels, elite ratings on surface.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Tactics teal from the crest's chalkboard. Links, focus ring, selected tab underline, positive deltas, wins, chart lines.

tokens.name: pitch
tokens.usage: Deep pitch teal. Tactics board and formation backgrounds, match-day hero bands. Text on it: #ffffff (6.9:1) or gold.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Scoreboard, top bar and the opponent's side of a fixture. Night uses the lifted crest-rim navy so it separates from the page; text on it is #eef1ea.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Defeats, injuries, red cards, wage-budget overruns, negative deltas. Always with a word or sign, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Yellow cards, expiring contracts, low morale, unhappy players.

tokens.name: rating-elite
tokens.usage: Attribute 16–20 (world class). Text on surface.

tokens.name: rating-good
tokens.usage: Attribute 11–15 (strong). Text on surface.

tokens.name: rating-average
tokens.usage: Attribute 6–10 (squad level). Text on surface.

tokens.name: rating-poor
tokens.usage: Attribute 1–5 (weak). Text on surface; the number always shows, never colour alone.

tokens.name: star-gold
tokens.usage: Filled stars for senior players (ability and potential). 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: star-silver
tokens.usage: Filled stars for youth players: in the U18 or U21 squad, or on a youth contract. Same 0.5–5 scale as gold. 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: star-empty
tokens.usage: Outline of an unfilled star slot. Outline only, never filled, so it can't be read as silver.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the navy band (top bar, scoreboard) in both themes (9.9:1 Night, 12.9:1 Day).

tokens.name: on-navy-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on navy: dates, labels, the score dash (4.6:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: form-win
tokens.usage: W chip in a team's form guide on navy; on-gold text inside.

tokens.name: form-loss
tokens.usage: L chip in a team's form guide on navy; on-gold text inside. D chips use on-navy-muted.

tokens.name: card-yellow
tokens.usage: The yellow card shape in commentary, scoreboards and ratings. Always outlined with line-strong and named in text or for screen readers.

tokens.name: card-red
tokens.usage: The red card shape. Always outlined with line-strong and named in text or for screen readers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding (dense rows), icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; gap between a stat and its label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gutters between panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections; page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Match-day hero and scoreboard padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rating chips, badges, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, panels, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Formation discs, squad-number pills, avatars.
